description_en: Queries the information about the processes that are detected in an application whitelist policy
description_zh: 查询应用白名单策略中应用的进程信息
name: DescribeWhiteListProcess

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. It is automatically obtained by the system
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the policy.

You can call the [DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
策略编号。
调用[DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the process. Valid values:

1: trusted
2: suspicious
3: malicious
parameters.help_zh:
进程类型。取值：
1：可信
2：可疑
3：恶意
parameters.name: process_type

parameters.help_en:
The item based on which you want to sort the returned results. Default value: process type. Valid values:

1: process type
2: degree of trustability
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中的排序方式。默认按照进程类型排序。取值：
1：进程类型
2：可信程度
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: descending order. Valid values:

1: ascending order
2: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序类型。默认降序排列。取值：
1：升序
2：降序
parameters.name: desc

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 data entries are returned per page.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。最大值为1000，每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示数据条数

CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据的最大条数

FilePath.description_en: The path to the process startup file

Id.description_en: The primary key of the process information

Level.description_en: The trust score of the process

Md5.description_en: The MD5 hash value of the process startup file

ProcessType.description_en:
The type of the process. Valid values:

1: trusted
2: suspicious
3: malicious
ProcessType.description_zh:
进程类型。取值：
1：可信
2：可疑
3：恶意

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the process is trusted. Valid values:

1: no
2: yes

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 分页查询时，数据总条数
